name: How long does it take for a water heater to produce hot water after repair?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for a water heater to produce hot water after repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes for your water heater to produce hot water after a repair depends on the type of repair and the size of your tank. After a simple reset or relight, a standard 40-gallon tank can take 30-60 minutes to fully heat. Larger tanks or those that were completely drained might take longer, potentially 1-2 hours. If a major component like a heating element was replaced, it will still follow these general heating times once fully operational. Your technician can provide a more precise estimate.
